top3_axes.mechanism: Keep the baseline spike definition and fade direction, but do not enter on the spike bar. Require the next completed 5m bar to reverse through the midpoint of the spike candle body before emitting the same fade-side intent. This delays entry until price itself shows exhaustion of the persistent jump impulse.
top3_axes.falsification: On a fresh prospective boundary under unchanged 14bps cost and exit/risk geometry, gross expectancy does not improve versus the frozen baseline or remains <=0, PF remains <1, or apparent improvement is only sample starvation/cosmetic trade deletion.
